headline: Record power margins lift earnings; outlook raised
summary_short: Vistra's Q3 2026 net income was $1,140 million versus $652 million a year ago, and Ongoing Operations Adjusted EBITDA rose over 50% to $2,378 million.
summary_long: Net income rose $488 million, driven primarily by higher EBITDA and a $375 million increase in unrealized mark-to-market gains on derivatives, partly offset by higher depreciation and amortization. The company raised the midpoint and narrowed 2026 Ongoing Operations Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $7.1-$7.5 billion and initiated 2027 guidance of $7.7-$8.5 billion. The board authorized an additional $1.5 billion of buybacks, and the Cogentrix acquisition (about 5,500 MW) closed in October.
confidence_notes: Resolver sourceLink pointed at a securities-offering 8-K without an earnings exhibit; the earnings release was found via WebSearch. Adjusted EBITDA is Ongoing Operations Adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP). GAAP net income includes a $559 million unrealized gain from hedges. Guidance ranges (2026 and 2027 EBITDA and FCFbG) are stated in the release but not written to the event shard (no sanctioned script).

drivers.explanation: Increase driven primarily by higher EBITDA and a $375 million rise in unrealized mark-to-market gains on derivatives, partly offset by higher depreciation and amortization.
Management cites a very hot summer with record ERCOT and PJM peak demand, nearly 95% fleet commercial availability and disciplined spring maintenance.
Guidance raised and 2027 initiated; new capacity came online including the 405 MW Pulaski solar facility under a Microsoft power purchase agreement.
